glosses: to place, to put, to locate, to position, to set, to bestow, to stand
to lodge, to accommodate, to put up, to settle

examples.text: Доктор поместил стетоскоп на грудь пациента.
examples.en: The doctor placed a stethoscope on the patient's chest.
Tom was sent away to an insane asylum.

examples.text: Я бы хотел поместить некоторые вещи в гостиничный сейф.
examples.en: I'd like to put some things in the hotel safe.
Tom put the chicken in the oven.

examples.text: Том поместил кусочек хлеба в тостер.
examples.en: Tom put a slice of bread into the toaster.
